news.titleEn: Oil prices surge as Iran-US conflict fuels Strait of Hormuz supply fears
news.conclusionEn: Brent crude surged more than 6% to above $107 a barrel on Sept. 10, its highest since May, as the US-Iran conflict intensified and Saudi oil output reportedly hit its lowest level since 1990.
news.conclusionZh: 布伦特原油9月10日暴涨逾6%至107美元上方，创5月以来新高。
news.whyEn: A sustained move above $100-$110 threatens to reignite global inflation just as the Fed weighs a rate decision, and raises the risk of a serious disruption to Strait of Hormuz shipping.
news.whyZh: 油价若持续高企恐重燃全球通胀，令美联储决策更复杂，并加剧霍尔木兹海峡断供风险。
news.detailEn: Brent jumped more than 6% to around $107.63 a barrel and WTI broke above $100 for the first time since mid-May, extending a rally of more than 10% over five sessions. The spike followed reports that Iran targeted US Navy vessels in the latest escalation of the conflict and that Saudi Arabia's oil output had fallen to its lowest level since 1990. Iran-backed Houthi forces have also stepped up attacks near the Bab al-Mandab Strait, widening the area of concern beyond Hormuz. Analysts warn a prolonged supply shock could push pump prices and shipping costs higher worldwide just as central banks assess whether to raise interest rates. Washington and Tehran have shown no signs of de-escalating, with both sides reportedly preparing for a longer conflict.
news.detailZh: 布伦特原油暴涨逾6%至约107.63美元/桶，WTI自5月中旬以来首次突破100美元，五个交易日累计涨幅超10%。此轮上涨源于有报道称伊朗在冲突升级中袭击了美国海军舰艇，且沙特石油产量已降至1990年以来最低水平。伊朗支持的胡塞武装也加强了对曼德海峡附近的袭击，令担忧范围从霍尔木兹海峡进一步扩大。分析师警告，若供应冲击持续，全球油价和运费可能进一步走高，恰逢各国央行评估是否加息之际。华盛顿和德黑兰均未显现降级迹象，双方据报都在为更长时间的冲突做准备。

news.titleEn: Wholesale inflation picked up in August, adding to bets on a Fed rate hike
news.conclusionEn: US producer prices rose 5.4% year-over-year in August, slightly hotter than expected, pushing traders' odds of a Fed rate hike at the Sept. 15-16 meeting up to about 70% ahead of Friday's CPI report.
news.conclusionZh: 8月美国PPI同比涨5.4%超预期，加息概率升至约70%，聚焦周五CPI数据。
news.whyEn: A rate hike into an already-slowing economy would be highly unusual, would push up borrowing costs and the dollar globally, and marks the most hawkish market pricing in years.
news.whyZh: 经济放缓期加息实属罕见，将推高全球融资成本和美元，是市场多年来最鹰派的定价。
news.detailEn: The Producer Price Index climbed 0.4% in August and 5.4% from a year earlier, with core PPI up 4.6% annually, both broadly in line with forecasts but confirming that energy-driven cost pressures are feeding through the supply chain. The data pushed the odds of a quarter-point Fed hike at the Sept. 15-16 meeting to around 70% on the CME FedWatch tool, up from about 61% earlier in the week. All eyes now turn to Friday's August CPI report, the last major inflation reading before the Fed meets, with economists expecting headline prices up 0.4% for the month and 3.4% annually. A hotter-than-expected print would further cement hike bets, while a softer one could still leave the decision close to a coin toss.
news.detailZh: 8月PPI环比上涨0.4%，同比涨5.4%，核心PPI同比涨4.6%，均大致符合预期，但印证了油价推动的成本压力正传导至供应链。数据令CME FedWatch工具显示的9月15至16日会议加息25个基点概率升至约70%，高于本周早些时候的约61%。市场目前聚焦周五公布的8月CPI，这是美联储会议前最后一份重要通胀数据，经济学家预计环比上涨0.4%，同比涨3.4%。若数据超预期偏热将进一步巩固加息押注，若偏软则决议仍可能接近五五开。

news.titleEn: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq fall for fourth straight day as bond yields jump, oil stays above $100
news.conclusionEn: US stocks fell for a fourth straight session on Sept. 10 as oil's surge and a jump in Treasury yields to a near three-year high fed growing bets on a Fed rate hike.
news.conclusionZh: 美股9月10日连跌四日，油价飙升叠加美债收益率创近三年新高。
news.whyEn: A synchronized rise in oil, yields and rate-hike odds tightens financial conditions across markets worldwide and pressures equity valuations, especially for growth and tech stocks.
news.whyZh: 油价、收益率与加息预期同步走高会收紧全球金融环境，冲击成长和科技股估值。
news.detailEn: The Dow fell 0.6%, the S&P 500 dropped 0.58% and the Nasdaq sank 0.65%, marking a fourth consecutive losing session for all three indexes. The 10-year Treasury yield climbed to 4.91%, its highest since 2023, while the 2-year yield rose to 4.53%, both reflecting growing expectations of a Fed rate hike next week. Brent crude crossed $105 a barrel and WTI topped $100 for the first time since mid-May, extending a more-than-10% rally over five sessions on Iran conflict fears. August producer prices rose in line with forecasts but confirmed that energy costs are pushing up wholesale inflation. Markets are now bracing for Friday's CPI report as the last major data point before the Fed's Sept. 15-16 meeting.
news.detailZh: 道指跌0.6%，标普500跌0.58%，纳指跌0.65%，三大指数连续第四个交易日收跌。10年期美债收益率升至4.91%，创2023年以来新高，2年期收益率升至4.53%，均反映市场对下周美联储加息预期升温。布伦特原油突破105美元，WTI自5月中旬以来首次站上100美元，受伊朗冲突担忧推动，五个交易日累计涨幅超10%。8月生产者价格数据基本符合预期，但证实能源成本正推高批发端通胀。市场目前正在等待周五公布的CPI报告，这是美联储9月15至16日会议前最后一项重要数据。

news.titleEn: DOJ Probes Nvidia's License Deal With Groq on Antitrust Concerns
news.conclusionEn: The US Justice Department is formally investigating whether Nvidia structured its roughly $20 billion licensing deal with AI chip startup Groq to dodge mandatory antitrust merger review.
news.conclusionZh: 美国司法部正式调查英伟达约200亿美元的Groq授权交易是否意在规避反垄断审查。
news.whyEn: It is the first formal US regulatory test of the 'reverse acquihire' deal structure that has funneled over $100 billion into AI startups while sidestepping merger review, and could reshape future AI dealmaking.
news.whyZh: 这是美国监管机构首次对已为AI初创公司引入逾千亿美元、却绕开并购审查的「反向收购挖人」交易展开正式调查，可能改变未来AI交易方式。
news.detailEn: Nvidia took a non-exclusive license to Groq's chip technology and hired several of its executives, including founder Jonathan Ross, without formally acquiring the company, a structure that avoided the Hart-Scott-Rodino merger filing an outright purchase would have required. The DOJ opened its inquiry shortly after the deal was announced in December and has since sent Nvidia a formal request for information. Investigators are examining whether the arrangement was deliberately designed to skirt antitrust scrutiny; potential outcomes could include fines, though unwinding the deal is seen as unlikely. Nvidia said the Groq deal reflects 'the American system working as designed to promote innovation, reward entrepreneurs, and benefit consumers.' A finding against Nvidia could ripple across the AI industry, where similar licensing-and-hiring deals have become common.
news.detailZh: 英伟达获得Groq芯片技术的非独家授权，并招揽了包括创始人乔纳森·罗斯在内的多名高管，但并未正式收购该公司——这一结构避开了整体收购本应触发的《哈特-斯科特-罗迪诺法》并购申报。司法部在交易于去年12月宣布后不久便启动调查，并已向英伟达发出正式信息索取函。调查人员正评估该安排是否刻意设计以规避反垄断审查；可能的结果包括罚款，但撤销交易的可能性较低。英伟达回应称，Groq交易体现了「美国体系按设计运作，以促进创新、奖励创业者、惠及消费者」。若英伟达被认定违规，可能波及整个AI行业中日益普遍的类似「授权+挖人」交易模式。

news.titleEn: Trump's $1 trillion-plus 'dividend' plan meets immediate bipartisan pushback
news.conclusionEn: President Trump's proposal to send Americans tariff-funded 'dividend' checks worth over $1 trillion drew swift opposition from lawmakers in both parties over its cost and design, weeks before the midterms.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普提出逾万亿美元关税「分红」支票计划，两党议员迅速表示反对。
news.whyEn: A payout this large would widen the federal deficit even as tariff revenue funds it, and the fight over who qualifies could become a flashpoint heading into the midterm elections.
news.whyZh: 如此规模的支票将扩大联邦赤字，谁有资格领取也可能成为中期选举的焦点争议。
news.detailEn: Trump has said tariff revenue, which he claims is running above $1 trillion a year, should fund direct payments of roughly $2,000 per qualifying adult, with Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent suggesting eligibility could be capped around $100,000 in income. Independent analysts, including the Tax Policy Center, say the payments would cost far more than tariffs actually bring in and would add to the deficit even under a phase-out design. Republican deficit hawks and Democrats have both criticized the plan, the former over fiscal cost and the latter over using tariffs, which function as a consumption tax largely borne by American businesses and shoppers, to fund it. The proposal has resurfaced repeatedly since late 2025 without payments materializing, and this latest push comes as Trump's party heads into a difficult midterm cycle.
news.detailZh: 特朗普表示，他所称每年超万亿美元的关税收入应用于向符合条件的成年人直接发放约2000美元，财政部长贝森特则建议收入上限可能定在约10万美元左右。包括税收政策中心在内的独立分析机构指出，这笔支出将远超关税实际收入，即便设计了退坡机制也会扩大财政赤字。共和党财政鹰派和民主党人都对该计划提出批评，前者担忧财政成本，后者则反对用本质上由美国企业和消费者承担的关税（相当于一种消费税）来买单。该提案自2025年底以来已多次被提及但迟迟未兑现，此次重提正值特朗普所在政党面临艰难的中期选举周期。

news.titleEn: Apple unveils iPhone Duo foldable, iPhone 18 Pro and Apple Watch Series 12 at 'Surprise and shine' event
news.conclusionEn: At its Sept. 9 event, Apple launched its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, priced from $1,999, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro line and Apple Watch Series 12, in new CEO John Ternus's first keynote.
news.conclusionZh: 苹果9月9日发布首款折叠屏iPhone Duo（起售1999美元）及iPhone 18 Pro等新品，系新CEO首秀。
news.whyEn: It is Apple's biggest hardware bet in years and a real-time test of whether a foldable can revive iPhone upgrade demand under Apple's first new CEO since Tim Cook.
news.whyZh: 这是苹果多年来最大的硬件押注，也是蒂姆·库克卸任后首任新CEO面临的换机需求考验。
news.detailEn: The iPhone Duo is a book-style foldable with an ultra-thin design, a 7.6-inch inner display and Touch ID rather than Face ID, starting at $1,999. The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max feature a new 2-nanometer A20 Pro chip, a smaller Dynamic Island, larger batteries and a variable-aperture main camera. Apple Watch Series 12 added new health-tracking sensors and refined hardware. Notably, Apple skipped a standard iPhone 18 model this year, pushing it and an iPhone Air successor to spring 2027 and splitting its once-unified annual launch for the first time. John Ternus, who took over as CEO from Tim Cook on Sept. 1, led the presentation as his first keynote in the role.
news.detailZh: iPhone Duo是一款书本式折叠屏手机，机身超薄，内屏7.6英寸，采用Touch ID而非面容ID，起售价1999美元。iPhone 18 Pro和Pro Max搭载全新2纳米A20 Pro芯片，灵动岛缩小、电池容量增大，并配备可变光圈主摄。Apple Watch Series 12新增健康监测传感器并升级了内部硬件。值得注意的是，苹果今年跳过了标准版iPhone 18，将其与下一代iPhone Air推迟到2027年春季发布，首次打破了以往统一的年度发布节奏。9月1日从蒂姆·库克手中接任CEO的约翰·特努斯主持了此次发布，这是他上任后的首场主题演讲。

news.titleEn: Chinese AI firm DeepSeek taps underwriters including Citic Securities for IPO: sources
news.conclusionEn: DeepSeek has hired Citic Securities and three other underwriters to prepare an IPO on Shanghai's STAR Market, aiming to list at a valuation of roughly $74 billion.
news.conclusionZh: DeepSeek聘请中信证券等四家承销商筹备上海科创板上市，估值约740亿美元。
news.whyEn: A successful listing would be one of the largest Chinese tech IPOs in years and signals major investor confidence in China's AI sector as it races to fund the compute costs of competing globally.
news.whyZh: 若成功上市将是多年来中国科技业最大规模IPO之一，反映投资者对中国AI产业竞逐全球算力的信心。
news.detailEn: DeepSeek, the Hangzhou-based AI startup known for its low-cost large language models, is completing a pre-IPO funding round that could value the company at about $74 billion before new investment, with plans to raise at least 10 billion yuan (roughly $1.4 billion) or more. The company aims to begin its IPO process this year to list on the Nasdaq-style STAR Market, with an eventual public debut possible in 2027. The fresh capital would go toward computing infrastructure, model development and talent retention as competition with rivals intensifies. DeepSeek's move mirrors domestic rival Moonshot AI, which is separately preparing a Hong Kong listing, underscoring a broader trend of Chinese AI firms turning to public markets to fund the escalating costs of the AI race.
news.detailZh: 这家总部位于杭州、以低成本大语言模型闻名的AI初创公司正在完成一轮Pre-IPO融资，投前估值约740亿美元，计划融资至少100亿元人民币（约14亿美元）甚至更多。公司计划今年启动IPO程序，在类似纳斯达克的科创板上市，最终可能于2027年正式挂牌。新募集资金将用于算力基础设施、模型研发和人才留存，以应对日益激烈的竞争。DeepSeek此举与国内对手月之暗面（Moonshot AI）正筹备香港上市的动作类似，凸显中国AI企业正普遍转向公开市场，为持续攀升的AI竞赛成本融资的趋势。

news.titleEn: Silver Falls 6%, Gold Also Dips Amid Rate Hike Expectations, Rising Oil Prices
news.conclusionEn: Silver tumbled about 6% and gold also slipped on Sept. 10 as rising Fed rate-hike expectations and surging oil prices pulled investors away from precious metals.
news.conclusionZh: 9月10日白银重挫约6%，黄金也下跌，因加息预期升温及油价飙升。
news.whyEn: A pullback in precious metals alongside rising yields and oil signals investors are repricing risk across nearly every asset class ahead of the Fed's decision, affecting savers and commodity-linked portfolios worldwide.
news.whyZh: 贵金属回落叠加收益率和油价上行，显示投资者正在美联储决议前重新评估几乎所有资产类别的风险。
news.detailEn: Silver dropped roughly 6% on the day, one of its sharpest single-session declines this year, while gold eased back from levels near $4,400 an ounce, holding around $4,383 even as safe-haven demand might normally be expected to rise. Higher Treasury yields raise the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding assets like gold and silver, and the prospect of a Fed rate hike next week has strengthened the dollar, both of which weighed on metals prices. Gold remains far below its all-time high of about $5,589 an ounce set in January 2026, but has still been supported this year by central bank buying and geopolitical uncertainty. Traders are watching Friday's CPI report for confirmation of the Fed's rate path, which will be a key driver for metals into year-end.
news.detailZh: 白银单日重挫约6%，是今年以来最大单日跌幅之一；黄金也从每盎司4400美元附近回落，徘徊在约4383美元，尽管避险需求原本可能因局势紧张而升温。美债收益率走高提升了持有黄金、白银等无息资产的机会成本，而下周美联储可能加息的预期也推升了美元，二者共同压制贵金属价格。黄金目前仍远低于2026年1月创下的约5589美元/盎司历史高点，但今年以来仍受到央行购金和地缘政治不确定性的支撑。交易员正关注周五公布的CPI报告，以确认美联储的加息路径，这将是贵金属年底前走势的关键驱动因素。

businessTips.explanationEn: A network effect occurs when a product or platform becomes more valuable to each user as more people join it, creating a self-reinforcing loop that is hard for competitors to replicate. It differs from simple economies of scale because the value comes from the user base itself, not just lower unit costs. Direct network effects mean users benefit directly from more users, like a messaging app; indirect ones happen through a second group, like more buyers attracting more sellers on a marketplace. Once strong enough, it becomes one of the most durable competitive advantages in business, which is why early growth, even at a loss, can be worth funding to reach critical mass.
businessTips.explanationZh: 网络效应是指一款产品或平台随着用户增多而对每个用户都变得更有价值，从而形成竞争对手难以复制的自我强化循环。它不同于单纯的规模经济，因为价值来自用户群体本身，而非单位成本的下降。直接网络效应指用户直接因更多用户受益（如即时通讯软件）；间接网络效应则通过另一群体产生，比如更多买家吸引更多卖家加入平台。网络效应一旦足够强大，便会成为商业中最持久的竞争优势之一，这也是为何早期即便亏损增长，为达到临界规模也可能值得投入。
businessTips.exampleEn: A ride-hailing app is nearly useless in a city with only 10 drivers and no riders. As it signs up more drivers, wait times drop, which attracts more riders, which in turn makes the app more attractive to drivers. The company deliberately loses money on early rides in a new city to spark this loop, betting that once it reaches a critical mass of both sides, growth becomes largely self-sustaining.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一款打车软件如果在某城市只有10名司机、没有乘客，几乎毫无用处。随着司机数量增加，等待时间缩短，从而吸引更多乘客，这又反过来让平台对司机更有吸引力。公司在新城市早期故意在每单上亏钱，正是为了启动这一循环，赌的是一旦双方都达到临界规模，增长将基本能自我维持。

businessTips.explanationEn: Customer acquisition cost is the total sales and marketing spend divided by the number of new customers gained in a period, showing exactly what it costs to win one paying customer. For a side hustle or early-stage startup, tracking CAC honestly, including your own time, ad spend and any free trials or discounts, is often the difference between a business that can scale and one that quietly loses money on every sale. The number only means something next to customer lifetime value (LTV); a healthy business generally needs LTV to be several times CAC. Many founders skip this math early on and only discover they are unprofitable per customer after they have already scaled up spending.
businessTips.explanationZh: 获客成本是指某段时间内的销售和营销总支出除以新增客户数，直观反映赢得一位付费客户到底要花多少钱。对副业或早期创业者来说，诚实地统计获客成本（包括自己的时间、广告支出以及任何免费试用或折扣）往往决定了这门生意能否规模化，还是在每一单上悄悄亏钱。这个数字只有和客户终身价值（LTV）放在一起才有意义，健康的生意通常需要LTV是获客成本的数倍。很多创业者早期忽略了这笔账，直到把营销支出扩大后才发现每个客户其实是亏本的。
businessTips.exampleEn: Someone selling handmade candles online spends $300 on ads in a month and gains 15 new customers, giving a CAC of $20 per customer. If the average customer only ever spends $15 with the business, every sale is a loss, and scaling up the ad budget would only accelerate the losses. Realizing this, the seller instead raises the average order value with bundles so LTV comfortably clears the $20 CAC before spending more on ads.
businessTips.exampleZh: 有人在网上卖手工蜡烛，一个月花300美元投放广告获得15位新客户，获客成本为每人20美元。如果客户平均只在这家店消费15美元，那么每笔交易都在亏钱，加大广告预算只会让亏损扩大。意识到这一点后，卖家转而通过套装组合提高客单价，让客户终身价值稳稳超过20美元的获客成本，之后再考虑加大广告投入。

businessTips.explanationEn: The real interest rate is the nominal interest rate minus the inflation rate, showing the actual growth in purchasing power an investor earns, not just the number printed on a savings account or bond. When inflation runs hot, as with oil-driven price pressures pushing up CPI and PPI, a nominal yield that looks attractive can still leave you poorer in real terms if prices are rising faster. This is why bond investors watch inflation data as closely as the interest rate itself, and why central banks raise rates specifically to push real rates higher and cool an overheating economy. A negative real rate effectively penalizes savers and encourages borrowing and spending instead.
businessTips.explanationZh: 实际利率等于名义利率减去通胀率，反映投资者购买力的真实增长，而不只是储蓄账户或债券上印着的那个数字。当通胀高企时（比如油价推动CPI和PPI上升），一个看似诱人的名义收益率仍可能因为物价涨得更快而让你的实际购买力缩水。这正是债券投资者密切关注通胀数据的原因，也是央行专门加息以推高实际利率、给过热经济降温的原因。负实际利率实际上是在惩罚储蓄者，鼓励人们借贷和消费。
businessTips.exampleEn: A savings account pays 4% a year, which sounds solid, but if inflation is running at 5% because of surging oil and food prices, the real interest rate is actually negative 1%. In practical terms, the saver can buy less with their money at year's end than they could today, even though the account balance grew. This is why, during periods of high inflation like the current oil-driven CPI spike, investors often shift toward assets like inflation-protected bonds or commodities instead of holding cash.
